text: かのじょに　プレゼントを　かうんだ　やっぱり　ピッピにんぎょう　だな！

structure.jp: かのじょに　プレゼントを　かうんだ
structure.en: I'm buying a present for my girlfriend

structure.jp: やっぱり　ピッピにんぎょう　だな！
structure.en: it's got to be a Poké Doll after all!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) after a verb gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. かうんだ = 'I'm buying one, you see'.
